show more\n\n") for (p in hidden) print_pub(p) cat("
\n\n") } } else { years <- sort(unique(sapply(items, function(x) as.numeric(field(x, "year", NA)))), decreasing = TRUE) years <- years[!is.na(years)] for (yr in years) { cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", yr)) these <- Filter(function(x) as.numeric(field(x, "year", NA)) == yr, items) for (p in these) print_pub(p) } } } ``` ## Preprints
